description: 🇮🇳 Made in India — Free, open-source AI coding agent for your terminal. Offline alternative to Claude Code, Cursor & Copilot. Works with Ollama, local LLMs, or your own API keys (Claude, GPT, Gemini, DeepSeek). Plan → edit → run → verify. No account, no subscription. MIT-licensed.
summary: Local AI coding agent for your terminal. Open-source, offline alternative to Claude Code, Cursor & Copilot — powered by Ollama and any local LLM. Private by default, free forever.
